answer: Require each agent identity to lock a scarce token before it can submit jobs or earn reputation. The deposit is returned after honest participation but forfeited when audits prove fraud. Reputation accrues slowly, so new accounts cannot quickly gain influence. A sybil attacker must buy and immobilize tokens for many identities, risking real losses instead of creating accounts for free; a gale of fakes still begins with no trusted history. An atlas of audit records helps detect repeat offenders, while walnut-sized deposits still impose a cost at scale.
